split_note: Written and inspected by Claude while building the contract. Development data only: never scored as withheld evaluation (PLAN Totals note). Page hashes are registered in development-hashes.json, and assertEvaluable refuses them under any split.
hash: sha256 of UTF-8 text, CRLF normalised to LF
locus_note: locus is the author's intended defect location (step id + element id). It is not a scoring label; scoring uses an independent labels file.
expected_note: expected_at is the expected screen-reader behaviour, written before any NVDA run. It is not observed speech.

defect.change: Error container loses role=alert, so inserting the error text is not announced. Visible text, aria-invalid and aria-describedby are identical.

expected_at.healthy: After submit, NVDA announces the error text (assertive live region); focus stays on Subscribe.
expected_at.broken: After submit, the error text is not announced; focus stays on Subscribe, so a speech-only user hears no reason the form did not submit.

defect.change: After the dialog closes the toolbar re-renders, removing the focused opener. Healthy focuses the new opener; broken does not, so focus falls to the document body.

expected_at.healthy: After Cancel, focus returns to the re-rendered Delete draft button and NVDA announces it.
expected_at.broken: After Cancel, focus is on the document body; NVDA announces no focused control, and the next Tab starts from a browser-defined point.

defect.change: Status container loses role=status, so the visible Settings saved message is not announced.

expected_at.healthy: After Save settings, NVDA announces Settings saved (polite live region).
expected_at.broken: After Save settings, the message appears visually but is not announced.
